entries.title: Build 465260 (0e9a11b)
notes: The updater no longer depends on how many releases other apps add
Updates are checked for size and integrity before they install

entries.title: Build 454186 (d931d98)
notes: Card packs: see the packs, the Party Pass and what is coming
Clearer text on the purple background
Online: the host can throw for a team that has left rock, paper, scissors
Frame graphs in Settings, to check the game runs smoothly

entries.title: Build 453764 (e342a3c)
notes: Comfort settings: reduce motion, high contrast, bigger text
Bigger buttons and better screen-reader support
Online: the host can skip a player who has dropped out; phones reconnect after a blip
Share your Daily stars and party wins; challenge a friend to crack a card

entries.title: Build 453537 (6594e14)
notes: Play apart, turn length, online topics, Play again, Rejoin game, success buzz

entries.title: Build 453342 (7541911)
notes: Online games: host a game and friends join from their phones or the web. Choose topics, each with its own card colour. 450 cards, 50 per topic, including a very cheeky Mature 18+ set. Card corners tidied up.

entries.title: Build 452943 (625a993)
notes: First release through the in-app updater. Includes the web version work, the rock-paper-scissors knockout for 3+ teams, 10 new cards (55 in all) and the build time in Settings › About.
